label: Location
depicts: Map pin outline with a round center ring and a pointed bottom tip
use_when: Use when the interface wants the simplest location pin without a base or extra frame.
avoid_when: Do not use for the grounded or framed location pins when the plain pointed drop matters.

label: Location
depicts: Map pin outline standing above a wide oval ground ring
use_when: Use when the interface wants a location pin that visibly rests on an oval ground ring.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain pin when the oval base beneath the pin is part of the form.

label: Location
depicts: Map pin outline sitting inside a low trapezoid base frame
use_when: Use when the interface wants a location pin paired with a low base frame instead of an oval ring.
avoid_when: Do not use for the plain or oval based pins when the trapezoid base is visible.

label: Map
depicts: Folded map outline with three vertical panels and two inner fold lines
use_when: Use when the interface wants a simple folded map instead of a location pin.
avoid_when: Do not use for the square map sign when the three folded panels should remain visible.

label: Map
depicts: Square map panel with a diagonal route line meeting a top ridge
use_when: Use when the interface wants a compact square map panel rather than a folded paper map.
avoid_when: Do not use for the folded map when the square panel and route line are the visible cues.
